data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 白无垢与庭前落叶
data.description: 神社庭前的婚礼准备间，爱瑠身穿纯白白无垢，双手轻轻托住层叠袖口。她发现一片小叶子落在衣摆，俯身把它拾起，随即为自己的短暂分心羞涩一笑；白色织纹在柔和日光里清楚可见。
data.action: 轻托婚礼衣袖，拾起落在白色衣摆上的小叶子。
data.promptProse: At the open threshold of the shrine preparation room, Chitanda kneels on the raised wooden veranda in her ivory brocade shiromuku. The closed garment pools in a crescent around her on the wood. She gathers the layered cloth of one sleeve with her left hand while her right thumb and forefinger lift a single red maple leaf from the folds of the train. She smiles at the distraction. Soft autumn light from the courtyard reaches the white crane brocade and the wood grain beside the paper doorway. Frame her hands, her face and the leaf against the white hem in one view.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling with the closed white wedding kimono pooled around her, she lifts a single maple leaf from the train with her fingertips. Courtyard light picks out the leaf and ivory brocade by the open screen.
